data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Miscellaneous topicals & wound care_

**Class:** Aluminium salt of sucrose octasulfate (cytoprotective)

## Mechanism of action
- Forms a protective barrier over erosions, binds growth factors (EGF, bFGF) to the wound and stimulates healing

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Erosions and ulcers: oral and genital ulcers (Behçet), radiation dermatitis, perianal and peristomal dermatitis, diaper dermatitis, burns, epidermolysis bullosa wounds

## Dose & formulations
- Paste/cream 4–7% or crushed tablet suspension applied 2–3 times daily

## Adverse effects
- Minimal

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity

## Pregnancy & lactation
Safe.

## Viva points
- Barrier + growth factor binding → wound healing

_Sources: Khopkar ch.28 (Sucralfate); Wolverton 4e ch.54. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
